agent_memory.py:136-152 _get_client retries chromadb.PersistentClient on every call while self._client is None; on failure it records _open_error and re-raises, on success sets _open_error=None and caches _client, so recovery needs no restart. open_error (154-164) returns None whenever _client is not None, so a late failed open from a concurrent executor thread cannot make later calls error. query_database.py:720-730 raises the memory-unavailable AgentRunError only when agent_memory.open_error is non-None. tools/_agent.py:40-74 get_agent caches the agent singleton, so the same memory instance is reused across calls. memory_info is built from components (query_database.py:683) independent of open_error, so it is unchanged while the store is open.

grep of src finds no _identifier_to_system. git diff 874474c..HEAD touches only agent_memory.py, server.py, query_database.py and a test; no default.py or system prompt edit. The agent_memory.py change only wraps the existing open in try/except to record _open_error and re-raise, and adds a read-only open_error property (agent_memory.py:136-164), so post-open memory failures are unchanged. The check in query_database.py (~718-730) runs after send_message completes and after components_to_blocks and the trace build, so the full agent turn runs first. The check only reads the open_error property via getattr and never calls _get_client, so a workflow-handled message makes no open attempt and errors only when a failure was recorded earlier. This is covered by test_turn_without_model_call_raises_only_when_failure_recorded.
